L4_CURATED.description: Broad external complete phage genomes; not temporally prospective
L4_CURATED.recommended_source: NCBI Virus/RefSeq complete Caudoviricetes or a separately frozen phage collection

L4_PROSPECTIVE.description: Genuine prospective newly public phage genomes
L4_PROSPECTIVE.recommended_source: NCBI Virus complete genomes filtered with --released-after 2026-09-29

L4_METAVIROME.description: Fixed-release metagenomic viral contigs; domain-shift analysis
L4_METAVIROME.release_date_rule: source release must be frozen in cohort provenance

primary_endpoints: candidate_burden_per_Mb = all frozen union regions / Mb
support-family composition of all frozen union regions
rank distribution is descriptive only; rank is not a positive/negative cutoff
cluster_weighting: If cluster_id is supplied, report 1/n_cluster weighted burden in addition to all-genome burden; never use cluster membership to retune the engine
novelty_annotation: FORBIDDEN in Stage04A; deferred to Stage04B after hashes freeze
confirmation: Optional after primary score freeze; not required for accelerated Stage04A primary burden scan
null_specificity: Planned as a separately frozen Stage04N dinucleotide-preserving null arm; not approximated with a weaker shuffle in this accelerated package
